name: guru-a
desc: A Surrey woman of about forty, a wellness influencer: breathy, slow, soothing, every word drawn out like a guided meditation, a faint vocal fry, completely sure of herself.

name: guru-b
desc: A West London woman of about forty who spent a gap year in Bali and never let it go: warm, airy, sing-song, a soft upward lilt, posh vowels gone hippy.

name: guru-c
desc: A Brighton woman of about forty, a sound-bath teacher: low, hushed, very calm, half-whispered, long pauses between words.

name: bro-a
desc: An Essex man of about thirty-eight, a City trader: a tense, urgent whisper, clipped, quick, trying not to be overheard.

name: bro-b
desc: A Home Counties man of about thirty-eight, private-school, a hedge-fund type: a sharp, posh, hissed whisper, impatient, used to being obeyed.

name: bro-c
desc: A South London man of about thirty-eight, a crypto investor: a hushed, excited whisper, fast, barely holding it in.

name: badcode-a
desc: A Yorkshire man of about fifty, retreat staff: flat, deadpan, polite, utterly unbothered, a till assistant reading out a total.

name: badcode-b
desc: A Bristol man of about forty, retreat staff: friendly, dry, matter-of-fact, the faint smile of someone who knows exactly what this place is.

name: badcode-c
desc: A Midlands man of about sixty, retreat staff: slow, gentle, deadpan, a little weary, like a car park attendant.
